source_caption:
🎥🚀: Futurama

After waking up a thousand years in the future, Fry struggles to find his place in a world filled with robots, aliens, and impossible technology. He finds a new family at Planet Express, where every delivery mission turns into a chaotic adventure that often threatens the fate of Earth—and sometimes the entire universe.

With unforgettable characters like the fearless Leela, the reckless Bender, and the eccentric Professor Farnsworth, Futurama balances outrageous sci-fi comedy with surprisingly emotional stories. Its sharp humour, clever satire, and heartfelt moments have made it one of the most beloved animated series of all time.

Blast off with the new season of Futurama streaming August 3 on Hulu and Disney+!

source_details.synopsis: Futurama is an American animated science fiction sitcom created by Matt Groening and developed by Groening and David X. Cohen for the Fox Broadcasting Company, and later revived by Comedy Central and then Hulu. The series follows Philip J. Fry, a young man who is cryogenically preserved for 1,000 years and revived on December 31, 2999. Fry finds work at the interplanetary delivery company Planet Express, working alongside the one-eyed mutant Leela and the robot Bender. The series was envisioned by Groening in the mid-1990s while working on The Simpsons; he brought Cohen, a Simpsons writer, aboard to develop storylines and characters to pitch the show to Fox.
